headline: Pennsylvania would put commercial data centers under the Department
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would put commercial data centers under the Department of Environmental Protection, which would decide whether a polluted or diminished water supply has been restored or replaced. Not passed.

91 measures in 21 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

149 measures in 38 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

1,900 measures tracked. 379 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 81 offices.
